phase: Phase 2: Reading Advantage Critical Security and XP Idempotency
summary: Phase 2 targeted gate (6 suites, 29 tests) passes; @reading-advantage/domain (350 pass) and @reading-advantage/api (216 pass) pass. Spec acceptance criteria for Reading (destructive ownership/tenant checks, audit events, XP idempotency, AI assessment/content validation) are met with real behavior tests. Two plan-text A5 issues detected: (a) plan claimed '45 pre-existing no-var errors' but baseline reading-advantage lint had 0 errors and Phase 2 introduced 47 no-var errors in the new Jest-scaffolded __tests__/ files; (b) claimed 26/26 tests where suite now reports 29/29. Both plan claims were corrected and the actual lint regression was resolved by scoping `no-var: off` to `__tests__/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}` in `apps/reading-advantage/eslint.config.mjs` (the `var` is required for Jest mock factory hoisting; a `let/const` replacement was tested and produced TDZ ReferenceErrors at runtime). Post-fix reading-advantage lint returns 0 errors, matching baseline. reading-advantage#check-types OOMs during tsc — a pre-existing infrastructure limit documented in plan.md line 88, not a Phase 2 regression (@reading-advantage/domain and @reading-advantage/api check-types both pass). Aggregate reading-advantage test failures (29 suites, 32 tests) are pre-existing (verified by re-running at baseline SHA); Phase 2 introduces zero new failing suites.
